name: Kinevo
tagline: The charging backbone for the world's shared fleets.
positioning: Kinevo is the enterprise charging network that powers e-bike, e-scooter, and e-moped fleets across cities — one grid, billed by the electron.

hero.h1: Every ride, charged. Every city, connected.
hero.sub: Kinevo unifies charging hardware, energy routing, and settlement into one platform — so fleet operators stop babysitting swap stations and start scaling continents.

features.title: One grid, every vehicle
features.description: Charge e-bikes, scooters, and mopeds from the same modular docks. Kinevo negotiates voltage and connector handshakes so your ops team never touches a firmware flag.

features.title: Energy routing in real time
features.description: Our dispatch engine pulls power when the grid is cheapest and greenest, then routes it to the docks your riders will actually reach first. Idle kilowatts become revenue.

features.title: Metered to the electron
features.description: Every kilowatt-hour is logged, attributed, and reconciled per fleet, per station, per corridor — audit-ready invoices without a spreadsheet in sight.

features.title: Uptime you can underwrite
features.description: Predictive fault detection flags a failing dock before a rider ever finds it. SLA dashboards give procurement the 99.95% they signed for.

features.title: Deploy in weeks, not quarters
features.description: Site survey to live network in under 30 days. Kinevo ships pre-provisioned docks and handles permitting workflows with your municipal partners.

features.title: Built for the fleet control room
features.description: A single console for battery health, station load, and swap logistics across every market — the operating layer your dispatchers have been faking in tabs.

testimonials.quote: We were losing 14% of our fleet to dead batteries every peak hour. Kinevo's energy routing cut that to under 3% and gave our finance team invoices they could actually reconcile.
testimonials.name: Marta Elgersen

testimonials.quote: Procurement wanted one contract, one SLA, one grid across nine cities. Kinevo was the only vendor that didn't blink. Go-live in Lisbon took nineteen days.
testimonials.name: Damian Ruecker

testimonials.quote: The per-electron metering ended a two-year argument with our energy partners. We finally know exactly what a charged scooter costs, down to the corridor.
testimonials.name: Priya Nandakumar

pricing.blurb: For single-city operators lighting up their first charging corridor.
For multi-market fleets that need one grid and one control room.
For national and cross-border networks with bespoke energy contracts.

homepage.footerBlurb: Kinevo is the charging backbone for shared micro-mobility — unifying hardware, energy, and settlement into one continental grid.
